name: house-mbezi
description: House Mbezi viewer: tools that regenerate the geometry, plans and model in estimated metres.

scripts.geometry: node tools/metres.mjs && node tools/plans.mjs && node tools/glb.mjs
scripts.render: node tools/render.mjs && sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 84 share-card.png --out share-card.jpg && rm share-card.png
